body:
Okay the moment that still undoes me: in May 2025, after six years of fighting, Taylor finally owned all six of her masters. Every album. Hers 🤍

That's the whole reason we built the Taylor's Version thread — it follows the re-recording campaign album by album, the way she reclaimed her life's work one vault at a time.

Fearless came back first in 2021 with six vault tracks. Then Red, with nine — including the ten-minute 'All Too Well' that debuted at No. 1. Speak Now, announced mid-show on the Eras Tour. 1989, called out from the SoFi stage.

Four re-recorded, all six owned, two still to come — and watching the timeline fill in, in order, is the best kind of receipts.

Photo: Taylor on the Eras Tour, Minneapolis 2023 — Michael Hicks (CC BY 2.0), via Wikimedia Commons.

why: 09-22 Taylor's Version thread hero, origin-story angle (window 09-21->25, slot 1 of 2). The 'one moment that made it worth building': May 2025, she owned all six masters again after the 2019 sale. Facts sourced to supabase/seed/lenses/threads.mjs (title 'Taylor's Version'/'Owning the masters', the 'reclaims her life's work one vault at a time' copy) and rerecords.mjs: Fearless TV 2021 = 6 vault tracks; Red TV = 9 vault tracks incl. All Too Well (10 Min) debuting No.1; Speak Now TV announced mid-Eras-Tour 2023; 1989 TV announced from the final SoFi show; debut + reputation still have no TV (2 to come); May 2025 Shamrock buyback = all six owned. Slide 2 = thread-taylors-version-screen.png (free/unburned), which shows the lens IN USE with the real '6 of 6 owned / 4 of 6 re-recorded' tracker — cool-feature-only satisfied. Media[0] = lover-minneapolis-act5-2023 tile: 7-day-clear (last posted 09-08, 14d ago), distinct photoId from the X sibling. DROPPED the calendar's claim that 'the re-recording story begins in the Lover era' — repo data contradicts it (masters sale June 2019 predates Lover era start 2019-08-23; Fearless TV announced Feb 2021, after Lover; eras.ts:187 calls Lover 'the first album she owned outright', i.e. OUTSIDE the reclaim story). So the photo is credited plainly as a tour photo with NO era-relevance claim (calendar's own photo-availability note permits this). photoEra unset: thread:taylors-version is a cross-era, non-themed family. Thread post = share-hook exempt. Standard sentence capitalization (strategy Voice 2026-09-10).

critique.rationale: Taylor's Version origin-story hero: the May 2025 moment she finally owned all six masters, then the album-by-album reclaim — Fearless (6 vault), Red's nine incl. the No. 1 ten-minute All Too Well, Speak Now, 1989. Slide 2 is the real thread tracker: 6 of 6 owned, 4 of 6 re-recorded. Sourced to threads/rerecords.mjs.
